delta: Old unconditional EXIT trap is replaced with state-aware cleanup. Before writer intent lock may be released; after flash_started=1 it is retained until complete slot/GPT/p11 readbacks set flash_complete=1.
HUP/INT/TERM or command/readback failure after possible firmware writer entry therefore retain uncertain-state lock. Exact replacement anchors are mandatory.
limitations: No generated flash script or device writer executed.
Retained advisory lock is evidence of uncertainty, not proof a detached writer has exited.
Safe retry or recovery still requires explicit review; no automatic retry, reboot or commit.
